purpose: Startup package/API and support-boundary inventory, not full algorithm/performance review

common.execution: Source and public interfaces only; no Moon/oracle/microbenchmark commands

cli.public_surface: OptionSpec/ParsedArgs, option helpers, parse and command catalog/contracts
cli.observed: Linear spec lookup per option; occurrences map plus order preserve repeated argument information; generic parser handles --, clusters, attached values and long=value.
boundaries: No parser/error-order changes accepted by inventory; universal map/catalog construction is not automatically worthwhile
Catalog entries may describe rejection boundaries and semantic IDs rather than literal aliases

stream.public_surface: 64KiB chunk_size/read_chunk; Line(data,terminated); LineScanner.new/next with configurable byte delimiter
stream.observed: Scanner searches pending from index0 after refill; take copies output and the entire remaining tail then clears/appends it.
boundaries: R1 cursor/amortized-compaction work is source-justified, not measured complete
Longest live record can grow beyond64KiB; block size is not an input cap

bytere.public_surface: Reversible C-byte text/bytes/argument adapter; compile; Pattern.find/group_count; Hit spans/captures
bytere.observed: Project BRE/ERE translator wraps built-in Regex; find obtains earliest start then scans candidate ends with newly composed bounded Regex to choose longest.
boundaries: Explicit pattern backreference/word assertion/engine-extension rejections; S1 matcher is project work
No fresh complexity/profile/compile-versus-scan measurements; do not declare entire matcher satisfactory
declaration_findings: Grep README engine-limit attribution is narrower than the plan's project-owned matcher obligation

gzipops.observed: Encoder delegates to released async gzip Encoder, decoder handles member headers/inflate/trailer integrity and writes chunks before later failure; compressed input is materialized.
boundaries: Three command consumers; 32KiB/dynamic compression/levels and incremental Reader decoder remain G work
Named metadata replacement is separate from codec project work

checksum.observed: MD5/SHA512 use incremental public crypto; SHA1 has pure project state; all feed64KiB reads; GNU untagged manifest parser/escaping and checks exist.
boundaries: O9 adds algorithm/tag/length/output modes with independent vectors; current tags are explicitly rejected
Standalone sha256sum is separate and must join impact closure; CR escaping discrepancy unverified

fsops.public_surface: Paths/working-directory/removal protection, metadata/output/unique-temp/copy/remove, update/backup decisions, timestamp comparisons/reads
fsops.observed: Copy preflight rejects unsafe existing regular/symlink targets before traversal effects; time/update/backup helpers centralize current policy.
boundaries: Permission reads/identity/readlink/hardlink/handle-truncation/arbitrary timestamp setters remain documented policy limits
Query reuse must preserve preflight/identity/race/error/policy ordering; no metadata-preserving EXDEV fallback

netops.public_surface: Transfer options/profiles/errors/phases/observations/result, transfer/retry classification, cookies and URL helpers; legacy fetch API
netops.observed: Pure HTTP/1 adapter uses public passthrough, phased deadlines/framing, bounded metadata and profile-specific prefix/sink/cookie/request-target handling.
boundaries: Strict/Curl/Wget distinctions and stage-0 partial-error precedence must survive reuse
Proxy CONNECT high-level parser and repeated header semantics remain project work; no automatic content decoding
Failed writer may have unknown additional effects; counters are a lower bound, not exact committed bytes
File retry uses path reset without descriptor/inode identity guarantee
declaration_findings: README calls some stage-0 transfer behavior candidate acceptance despite later published stage-0 support record; reconcile current wording without rewriting historical evidence

process.public_surface: Complete environment, ExecutionContext, ChildSpec/child/run, POSIX launch status mapping, file redirections/pipe
process.observed: run supplies literal argv/cwd/full explicit environment and hard_cancel to released async process; inherit_env=false.
boundaries: Direct child only; process tree/groups and daemon-owned resources require separate ownership/observation logic
No full terminal/session or soft-signal contract implied

shell.observed: Session owns mutable variables/cwd/status/functions/input and pending source; feed parses accumulated text then runs jobs, preserving incomplete-input state.
boundaries: Current declared language only; no #31 expansion/PTY/job-control acceptance
Any invocation cache must invalidate for mutable environment/cwd/session changes

jq_filter.observed: Recursive public-AST lowering adapts Unicode-scalar string Slice to explode/slice/implode, leaves path assignment targets as locations and traverses other expression nodes.
boundaries: Retain moonjq0.2.0/current language/numeric/order/error boundaries; no full jq language or streaming evaluator
AST/intermediate optimization needs operation-equivalent measurements and integrated command evidence

time_zone.observed: TZ/TZDIR or host TZif plus POSIX future-rule parsing; current transition selection scans linearly; at_local checks candidate offsets and rejects ambiguous/gap times.
boundaries: Required binary-search/invocation cache is future work; no performance claim
Cache identity must include TZ/TZDIR/source/session changes; missing host database remains explicit failure

platform.public_surface: Platform/standard streams/terminal policy, path separators and capability predicates, POSIX EXDEV classification
platform.observed: File-kind/regular-size/time/access reads return supported; permission mutation and symlink creation reject Windows; permission reads/setters/hardlink/readlink/special-file policy/is_terminal currently false.
boundaries: These booleans are project policy/verified baseline, not proof of current dependency API absence
Terminal auto detection is false; explicit interaction/color decisions remain separate
EXDEV classification is POSIX18 only; Windows rename domains remain unclassified
declaration_findings: is_terminal comment cites async0.22.4 while workspace core depends0.22.5; lift only after public API and backend evidence

cross_package_declaration_debt.finding: core README still calls0.7.0/async0.22.5 an unpublished workspace candidate, although current support record declares cli/core0.7.0 stage-0 publication. This is current prose debt; keep historical reports and unmodified command candidates distinct.
